name: Sugar Body Scrub
description: A soft, fine-grain sugar base that melts against warm skin. Gentle enough for daily use, made to leave skin smooth without stripping it.

name: Sea Salt Body Scrub
description: A coarser mineral-rich salt blend for deeper exfoliation. Best for elbows, heels, and anywhere that needs a little more attention.

name: Coffee Energising Scrub
description: Ground coffee and natural oils in one invigorating blend, made for mornings that need a little help getting started.

name: Coconut Milk Scrub
description: A creamy, hydrating scrub built around coconut milk, for skin that wants softness more than intensity.

name: Charcoal Detox Scrub
description: Activated charcoal to draw out impurities, paired with a light natural oil base so skin isn't left feeling tight.

name: Oat & Honey Scrub
description: A soothing, low-irritation blend for sensitive skin, with fine oats and real honey.
